description: Dokan desktop shell — the main window is navigated to the sidecar's loopback origin, which Tauri treats as a REMOTE context (the local origin is the tauri:// asset protocol). A capability reaches a remote webview only when its origin is listed under remote.urls and its app commands are granted, so the vault gate's IPC bridge (issue #141) is declared here for loopback only. In development the webview loads the vite dev server on the app's own hostname (dokan.localhost, #343) rather than the shared `localhost`, whose pages are served by every other local service.
